title: sqliteRow
responsibility: Decodes a SQLite result row into model properties, restoring JSON values and booleans.

inputs.name: sqliteRow.model
inputs.description: The table model that maps stored columns back to application properties and types.

inputs.name: sqliteRow.row
inputs.description: A row returned by SQLite, or null or undefined when no row was found.

outputs.name: sqliteRow
outputs.description: A record keyed by model properties with JSON and boolean columns decoded, or null for an absent row.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: A malformed stored JSON value cannot be decoded and raises a parse error.
